'''Cote''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His unit was tasked with securing the [[Lower Wilds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], though Cote's commanding officer [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Varless]] refused to question their orders despite the fates of previous squads sent on the same mission.<ref name="TOR" />
